text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
Uuugh... It hurts,
my head feels all sharp and achy...

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
Why does Teacher have to get so mad...?
Mom and Dad would neeeever get mad at me.
choice_data_list: Why did the teacher get mad at you?
Why did the teacher get mad at you?

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
I wanted to see Prez, so just as I was
about to open the Student Council room door—

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text: "Teio-san! You must not enter the student council room without permission!" ...apparently.

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
Geez, you didn't have to yell
right into my ear like that~~!

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
...Ow-ow-ow.
Just thinking about it made it start hurting all over again...

And so, Tokai Teio found herself
plagued by a headache...
